name: Vegetable Pulao
steps: Rinse basmati rice gently and soak for 20 minutes, then drain well. Soaking is additional to the cooking time. Cut the carrot and beans into small, evenly sized pieces.
Heat oil in a heavy saucepan with a tight-fitting lid. Add cumin over medium heat and let it sizzle until fragrant, then add carrot, beans and peas.
Stir the vegetables for about 3 minutes to coat them in the seasoned oil. Add the drained rice and fold gently, taking care not to break the grains.
Pour in the measured water and add salt. Bring to a boil, stir once, then cover tightly and reduce the heat to low.
Cook for 12–15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the rice and vegetables are tender. If the rice remains firm in a dry pan, add a small splash of hot water and cook covered a little longer.
Switch off the heat and rest covered for 5 minutes. Fluff gently from the edges before serving, distributing the vegetables without vigorous stirring.
tips: Soaking time is additional. Adjust water to rice variety and vessel.
substitutions: Any substitution changes the recipe: recheck allergies, Jain rules and quantities.
passiveTime: See soaking/resting time in the steps
notes: Prices are sample ingredient-cost assumptions. Replace with supplier rates before procurement.
